info.name: Retrieve contracts between person and different types of competitors.

params.name: page
params.description: The number of page to be returned. The default value is 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The size of the page to be returned. The default value is 10.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to 'order by' by. Descending ordering also allowed. Fields to order by for this endpoint: (competitor.Id, competitor.Name, person.Id, person.Name, player.Id, player.Name, createdon, modifiedon, updatedcount, startDate, endDate, isactive)

params.name: filter
params.description: The field to 'filter' by. Check main description for filter comparators. Fields to filter by for this endpoint: (competitor.Id, competitor.Name, person.Id, person.Name, player.Id, player.Name, createdon, modifiedon, updatedcount, startDate, endDate, isactive)

items.docs: Returns the persons, the corresponding player and the competitor with which the person has contract of wrapped inside a HATEOAS model
